points.note: Large end-on brass helical gear at the base, lower-left; projected face/hub center. Closer/more visible of the two cylinder gears.
Side-on horizontal helical cylinder receding back-right toward the cone post; midpoint of the visible cylinder silhouette along its axis (far end occluded).
Upper corner of the topmost/front-most arm's foreshortened tip end-face; the two tip corners nearly collapse in this steeply foreshortened view.
Lower corner of the same arm's tip end-face (~19px below tip_left due to foreshortening).
Nearest (lowest, image-center) base corner, where the back face meets the right side face at the bottom = back-right corner for a back-right camera.
Far-left bottom base corner (=back-left, image-left); left/front faces turn away into shadow beyond it.
Far-right bottom base corner (=front-right), receding toward the front; in shadow.
Near-center top-frame corner above the nearest base corner (=back-right); partly obscured by the silver rack/lever above.

occluded.reason: Chain sprocket sits beside the crank drive gear on the FRONT/platen side of the machine; not visible from the back-right.
Lower crank-axle sprocket is on the front/occluded side (only a hanging chain segment is glimpsed near the fan pivot).
Cone gear stack is hidden behind the green triangular cone-post casting and in deep shadow at the base.
Butt/pivot end of every fan arm converges at the central column and is occluded by the amplitude-rod bundle and the guide post.
Same as butt_left: pivot end occluded at the central column.
Front-left base corner is on the far side of the machine, occluded.
Front-left top-frame corner is on the far side, occluded behind the casting.

orientation_note: Camera is off the machine's back-right corner: the long green face receding to image-left is the BACK face, the short face receding to image-right is the RIGHT side, and the nearest (lowest) corner where they meet is the back-right corner. Left/front sides face away and are occluded. Machine-relative corner naming: nearest corner = back-right, image-left = back-left, image-right = front-right.
